name: DS[Daemon Slave]NTR Namaiki Akuma Musume Netorare Choukyou
original_name: DS[daemon slave]NTR なまいき悪魔娘ネトラレ調教
source:
This is my life with a demon girl.
She appeared suddenly, and since then we've been together.
One day I received a strange email and video.
The video was her with another man... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE075909.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
这就是我与恶魔女孩的生活。
她突然出现在我面前，此后，我们便一直在一起。
一天，我收到了一封奇怪的电子邮件和一段视频。
视频里，是她与另一个男人…

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE075909.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
